title: Spin Animation Type on Map Event

posts.author: Vyndicate
posts.body:
Is it possible to do this animation type without stop like in 2003?
When I use spin animation on MV, it will stop spinning when interact with it

posts.author: ValentinaSama67
posts.body:
Just have it on a stepping animation, like so, it won't stop even if you interact with it:
However, you would be limited to 3 frames, unless you use a plugin to have more frames. Like
galv's character frames
, which allows you to have 4 or more frames.

posts.author: coucassi
posts.body: You can also use another event to set a move route on the event you want to spin. Mark Repeat Movement in the move route, run the event once and your spinning event won't stop spinning, until you set another move route.

posts.author: utunnels
coucassi
posts.body:
Good call!
But why the script? You can just enable and disable the FixDirection in the move route command, or am I missing something?

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: I guess it is a habit. Because route has a delay between them, so use script is just safer.

posts.author: coucassi
posts.body:

I never had need for this level of precision, so I never noticed the difference!
